beschreibung: Augsburg’s Manuel Baum questions rulebook’s double standard after seeing red in Bundesliga win – Augsburg head coach Manuel Baum acknowledged that referee Martin Petersen was correct to send him off against Mainz, but questioned why coaches face a straight red card for an offence that would ordinarily earn a player a booking.

Bayern Munich’s Michael Olise set to miss Lille game – Bayern Munich face Lille in the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday night, but they will likely be without Michael Olise after the Frenchman suffered an injury in Friday’s 1-1 draw…
